test_cases.title: Synthetic Sensor Generation From Truth State
test_cases.setup: Instantiate sim_sensors with a deterministic sim_dynamics truth state providing fixed position, velocity, attitude, angular rate, and specific force.
procedure: Initialize sim_sensors with zero noise, zero bias, and zero dropout configuration.
Step the model once with a known truth state vector.
Read the synthetic IMU, barometer, and GPS outputs from the model.
Compare each output against the analytically-expected value derived from the truth state.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: All three sensor outputs (IMU, baro, GPS) are populated and match the analytical expectations within floating-point tolerance.

test_cases.title: Synthetic IMU Sample Rate Is 200 Hz
test_cases.setup: Instantiate sim_sensors and run for one simulated second with a constant truth state.
procedure: Configure sim_sensors with default parameters and a 1.0 s run duration.
Advance simulated time at the smallest sub-step the model supports.
Count the number of distinct synthetic IMU samples emitted during the run.
Record timestamps of consecutive IMU samples.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Exactly 200 synthetic IMU samples are emitted in 1.0 s and inter-sample period is 5.0 ms within +/-1 sub-step tolerance.

test_cases.title: Synthetic Accelerometer Saturates At Plus Or Minus 16 G
test_cases.setup: Instantiate sim_sensors with zero noise and zero bias.
procedure: Drive truth specific force on the X axis to +50 G and step the model.
Read the synthetic accelerometer X output and record it.
Drive truth specific force on the X axis to -50 G and step the model.
Read the synthetic accelerometer X output and record it.
Repeat for the Y and Z axes.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Accelerometer outputs are clamped to +16 G for positive overrange inputs and -16 G for negative overrange inputs on all three axes.

test_cases.title: Synthetic Gyroscope Saturates At Plus Or Minus 2000 dps
test_cases.setup: Instantiate sim_sensors with zero noise and zero bias.
procedure: Drive truth angular rate on the X axis to +5000 dps and step the model.
Read the synthetic gyroscope X output and record it.
Drive truth angular rate on the X axis to -5000 dps and step the model.
Read the synthetic gyroscope X output and record it.
Repeat for the Y and Z axes.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Gyroscope outputs are clamped to +2000 dps for positive overrange inputs and -2000 dps for negative overrange inputs on all three axes.

test_cases.title: Synthetic IMU 16-bit Quantization Resolution
test_cases.setup: Instantiate sim_sensors with zero noise and zero bias and configured full-scale ranges of +/-16 G and +/-2000 dps.
procedure: Sweep truth specific force across the full +/-16 G range in fine steps and record raw counts emitted.
Sweep truth angular rate across the full +/-2000 dps range in fine steps and record raw counts emitted.
Verify emitted counts are signed 16-bit integers.
Verify the count delta per LSB matches the configured full-scale divided by 32768.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Emitted IMU counts span the signed 16-bit range, increment monotonically with input, and match the configured LSB scaling within one count.

test_cases.title: Configurable IMU White Noise Statistics
test_cases.setup: Instantiate sim_sensors with zero bias, a constant zero-input truth state, and a configured noise standard deviation sigma_a for accelerometer and sigma_g for gyroscope.
procedure: Run the model for at least 10000 IMU samples with the configured noise parameters.
Collect the synthetic accelerometer and gyroscope sample streams per axis.
Compute the sample mean and sample standard deviation per axis.
Compare results against the configured sigma values.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Per-axis sample mean is zero within 3*sigma/sqrt(N), and sample standard deviation matches configured sigma within 5 percent.

test_cases.title: Configurable IMU Bias Offsets Mean Output
test_cases.setup: Instantiate sim_sensors with zero noise and a configured non-zero bias vector for accelerometer and gyroscope.
procedure: Hold truth specific force and angular rate at zero.
Step the model for at least 1000 IMU samples.
Compute the per-axis sample mean of accelerometer and gyroscope outputs.
Compare the per-axis means against the configured bias values.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Per-axis sample mean equals the configured bias for both accelerometer and gyroscope within floating-point tolerance.

test_cases.title: Synthetic Barometer Sample Rate Is 20 Hz
test_cases.setup: Instantiate sim_sensors with default parameters and a constant truth altitude.
procedure: Run the model for 1.0 s of simulated time.
Count the number of synthetic barometer samples emitted.
Record timestamps of consecutive barometer samples.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Exactly 20 synthetic barometer samples are emitted in 1.0 s and inter-sample period is 50.0 ms within +/-1 sub-step tolerance.

test_cases.title: Standard Atmosphere Pressure And Temperature From Altitude
test_cases.setup: Instantiate sim_sensors with zero baro noise and configured to use the standard atmosphere model.
procedure: Set truth altitude to 0 m MSL and read pressure and temperature.
Set truth altitude to 1000 m MSL and read pressure and temperature.
Set truth altitude to 5000 m MSL and read pressure and temperature.
Compare each (pressure, temperature) pair against the U.S. Standard Atmosphere 1976 reference values.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Pressure matches reference within 0.1 percent and temperature matches within 0.1 K at all three altitudes.

test_cases.title: Configurable Barometer Noise Statistics
test_cases.setup: Instantiate sim_sensors with constant truth altitude and configured baro noise standard deviation sigma_p.
procedure: Run the model for at least 5000 barometer samples.
Subtract the noise-free standard-atmosphere pressure from each sample to obtain residuals.
Compute sample mean and sample standard deviation of the residual stream.
Compare against the configured sigma_p.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Residual mean is zero within 3*sigma/sqrt(N), and residual standard deviation matches configured sigma_p within 5 percent.

test_cases.title: Synthetic GPS Sample Rate Is 5 Hz
test_cases.setup: Instantiate sim_sensors with default parameters and a constant truth position.
procedure: Run the model for 1.0 s of simulated time.
Count the number of synthetic GPS fixes emitted.
Record timestamps of consecutive GPS fixes.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Exactly 5 synthetic GPS fixes are emitted in 1.0 s and inter-sample period is 200.0 ms within +/-1 sub-step tolerance.

test_cases.title: Configurable GPS Quality Fields Propagated To Fix
test_cases.setup: Instantiate sim_sensors with configured HDOP=1.5, VDOP=2.0, fix_latency=120 ms, and satellites=8.
procedure: Step the model and capture the next emitted GPS fix.
Read HDOP, VDOP, and satellite-count fields from the fix.
Compare the fix timestamp against the truth-state timestamp at which the fix was sampled.
Verify the timestamp delta equals the configured fix_latency.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Emitted GPS fix carries HDOP=1.5, VDOP=2.0, satellites=8, and a sample-to-emit delay equal to 120 ms within one sim sub-step.

test_cases.title: GPS Dropout Window Suppresses Fixes
test_cases.setup: Instantiate sim_sensors with a configured dropout window from t=2.0 s to t=4.0 s.
procedure: Run the model from t=0.0 s to t=6.0 s with a constant truth position.
Record the timestamps of all emitted GPS fixes.
Count fixes in the intervals [0,2), [2,4], and (4,6].
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Zero GPS fixes are emitted during [2,4] s, and fixes resume at the configured 5 Hz cadence in (4,6].

test_cases.title: Sensor Output Frames And Units Parity Inspection
test_cases.setup: Open the sim_sensors header defining the synthetic sensor output structures and the FSW real-sensor driver headers (IMU, baro, GPS).
procedure: Compare the accelerometer output frame and units (body frame, m/s^2 or raw counts with documented LSB) between sim_sensors and the FSW IMU driver.
Compare the gyroscope output frame and units (body frame, rad/s or raw counts with documented LSB) between sim_sensors and the FSW IMU driver.
Compare the barometer output units (Pa for pressure, K for temperature) between sim_sensors and the FSW baro driver.
Compare the GPS fix fields (latitude/longitude in degrees, altitude in meters MSL, HDOP/VDOP unitless, satellite count integer) between sim_sensors and the FSW GPS driver.
Record any frame or unit mismatch.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Reviewer confirms every sensor output field in sim_sensors uses the same frame and units as the corresponding FSW real-sensor driver field.

test_cases.title: Sensor Parameters Loaded From Sim Scenario
test_cases.setup: Author a sim_scenario configuration containing distinct values for IMU noise, IMU bias, baro noise, GPS quality, and a GPS dropout window.
procedure: Load the configured sim_scenario into sim_sensors at initialization.
Read back the in-memory IMU noise, IMU bias, baro noise, and GPS quality parameters from the model.
Read back the configured GPS dropout window from the model.
Compare every read-back value against the corresponding sim_scenario field.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: All noise, bias, GPS quality, and dropout parameters present in the model exactly match the sim_scenario configuration values.

test_cases.title: Closed-Loop Sim Sensors Feed FSW POSIX Drivers
test_cases.setup: Build the Trick sim with sim_dynamics, sim_sensors, and the FSW POSIX driver layer connected. Configure a benign trajectory scenario.
procedure: Run the Trick sim for 10 s of simulated time.
Record the synthetic measurements emitted by sim_sensors.
Record the measurements consumed by the FSW IMU, baro, and GPS POSIX drivers.
Compare the consumed values against the emitted values sample-by-sample.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Every measurement consumed by an FSW POSIX driver matches the corresponding sim_sensors emission in value, frame, and units.
